plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the Pokémon Chronicles series of in ( ).
 
==Single volume releases==
The Pokémon Chronicles single volumes were released by in 2005 and 2006. The four volumes contain all 22 episodes, merging The Legend of Thunder! into one "feature length episode."

Volume 1 is available on DVD and VHS; the other volumes are only available on DVD. Volume 2 is a "Special Bumper Volume" which includes the DVDs for both Volume 2 and Volume 3 in the same case; Volume 3 was not sold separately. Volume 4 is marketed as a "Bumper Edition", containing more episodes than other volumes, and was not included in the box set.

"Aerodactyl" is misspelled as "Aerodcactyl" in the title of the episode Putting the Air Back in Aerodactyl! in the DVD menus of Volume 3. The DVDs do not include English closed captioning.

 

==Box set==
 
The Pokémon Chronicles box set was released by on September 5, 2005. The set contains three volumes within a cardboard sleeve, containing 15 episodes across them combined, although the first three episodes are merged into The Legend of Thunder! as a "feature length episode"; it does not contain the whole Pokémon Chronicles series due to lacking Volume 4. Its catalogue number is CTD10356.

The discs are identical to those released in the individual volumes. "Aerodactyl" is misspelled as "Aerodcactyl" in the title of the episode Putting the Air Back in Aerodactyl! in the DVD menus of Volume 3. The DVDs do not include English closed captioning.
